title: Making Space on a Crowded Desk
context: Clara 收拾堆满纸张的书桌，室友 Jamie 帮她区分需要保留和处理的物品。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和练习题均为原创，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: I can't find my notebook under all these papers.
dialogue.zh: 这么多纸堆在一起，我找不到笔记本了。

dialogue.speaker: Jamie
dialogue.en: Let's clear a little space first. Are these receipts still useful?
dialogue.zh: 我们先腾出一点地方吧。这些收据还有用吗？

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Some are. I'll check the dates before I throw any away.
dialogue.zh: 有些有用。我扔之前会先看看日期。

dialogue.speaker: Jamie
dialogue.en: I'll put the pens in this cup while you sort them.
dialogue.zh: 你整理收据的时候，我把笔放进这个杯子里。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Thanks. The notebook was under that stack of mail!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。笔记本原来在那一叠邮件下面！

dialogue.speaker: Jamie
dialogue.en: Would a tray help you keep new mail together?
dialogue.zh: 用个托盘把新邮件放在一起会有帮助吗？

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Yes. I can put the tray on the left side of the desk.
dialogue.zh: 会。我可以把托盘放在桌子左边。

dialogue.speaker: Jamie
dialogue.en: What about the charger that's stretched across the table?
dialogue.zh: 那根横在桌上的充电线怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: I'll unplug it and coil it up when I'm not using it.
dialogue.zh: 不用的时候我会拔掉插头，把它绕好。

dialogue.speaker: Jamie
dialogue.en: There's enough room for your notebook now.
dialogue.zh: 现在有足够的空间放你的笔记本了。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Much better. I'll spend a few minutes sorting the desk each Friday.
dialogue.zh: 好多了。我以后每周五花几分钟整理桌面。

dialogue.speaker: Jamie
dialogue.en: That sounds doable. Now you can start your work.
dialogue.zh: 听起来可以做到。现在你可以开始工作了。

expressions.example: Let's clear some space for the new shelf.
Don't throw away that envelope yet.
I'll sort the photos by date.
There's a stack of magazines by the sofa.
Coil up the cable and put it in the drawer.

pronunciation: desk 末尾 /sk/ 都要发出；charger 重读第一音节，开头和中间的字母组合都含 /dʒ/ 音。

practice.title: Part 1 · Workspaces
practice.prompt: Do you prefer a tidy desk?
practice.answer: Yes. I find it easier to focus when I can find my notebook and pens. I try to clear my desk at the end of the day.

practice.title: Part 2 · Organizing a space
practice.prompt: Describe a space you organized. Say what it was like before, what you did, and how you felt afterward.
practice.answer: My desk was covered with papers, and I kept losing my notebook. One weekend my roommate helped me make space. I checked some old receipts while he put the pens in a cup. We found my notebook under a stack of mail and placed a tray on the desk for new letters. Afterward I could see the surface again, and starting my work felt much easier. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Organization
practice.prompt: How can an organized workspace affect the way people work?
practice.answer: It can save time because useful things are easier to find. However, people organize differently, so a system should fit the work they actually do.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读整理过程，再说明你如何处理桌上的纸张和充电线。
practice.answer: I'll check these papers before I throw any away. I can put the new mail in a tray and coil up the charger.
